Is China National Radio 1 still on shortwave?

Yes. As of November 14, 2026, China National Radio 1 is in the B-26 shortwave schedule with 123 scheduled broadcasts on 46 frequencies (4750, 4800, 5945, 5965, 5985, 6000 kHz and more). The schedule comes from EIBI and is rebuilt daily; stations can change frequencies at short notice.

What time is China National Radio 1 on shortwave?

China National Radio 1 is scheduled in 44 UTC time windows this season, from 00:00–06:00 UTC through 23:30–06:00 UTC. No English broadcasts are listed this season. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.
